$comment: B0: the template for a new business. NEVER loaded (a file whose name starts with _ is skipped). Copy it to config/businesses/<id>.json and fill in every field; README 'Adding a business' has the steps. The fields:
id: the business id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; the same as the file name (<id>.json); stored as business_id on every job, run, routine, approval, ledger row and event
name: the name shown on its floor and in the spend dialog
floor: a whole number, 1 or more, not used by another business (floor 0 is the shared floor: Finance, Compliance, OVERSEER and the lounge)
departments: the keys of its departments in config/office.json (each department belongs to one business or to the shared floor); an empty list shows an empty, labelled floor
lines: the ids of its lines in config/lines/ (each line belongs to exactly one business); its jobs, runs and routines carry this business's id
agents: the keys of its agents in config/agents/ (each agent belongs to one business, or to the shared floor in config/office.json shared.agents); every agent its lines use must be listed
monthlyBudgetUsd: a positive number: the most this business may spend in a Dublin calendar month; the guard refuses a call past it and the spend dialog shows it
dailyCapUsd: optional: a positive number at most the station's caps.perDayUsd; the lower of the two applies to this business's spend in a Dublin day (left out: the station's day cap applies)
allowedOutbound: the outbound actions this business may take, e.g. ["etsy:read-own-shop"]; [] = none (the default). An outbound action also needs the owner's approval each time (DECISIONS.md 'B0: building rules')
dataDir: where its files live, relative to the data root, e.g. "businesses/<id>/" (a new business must use businesses/<id>/); its agents' file tools are jailed to it. "." is today's layout and is allowed for etsy-shop only
ownerApprovalRequired: true (the default and, under the building rules, the only value accepted): every agent output is a draft until the owner approves it
